{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column again to confirm case sensitivity
print(f"Unique values in 'arm': {trial_df['arm'].unique()}")

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the TREATMENT arm
# Note: The column name is 'responded', not 'response'
treatment_arm = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']
print(f"Number of patients in TREATMENT arm: {len(treatment_arm)}")
print(f"Response distribution in TREATMENT arm:")
print(treatment_arm['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))"}
